verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent supports a configurable 'persona' with tunable settings and natural-language runbooks/skills to standardize behavior, which gives leaders some control over tone (pylon-docs-57, pylon-docs-15, pylon-docs-20, pylon-docs-73). However, there is no documentation addressing multi-language support or evidence that tone/brand voice remains consistent across topics and languages. Missing for 10: explicit brand-voice/tone customization controls beyond persona tuning, and evidence of consistency across languages/topics.
